thread:
carla_finance: Heads up - invoice INV-2026-03-09 for ACME shows ~40,032,000 embedding units for Feb 20-21. Ledger shows ~4,003,200. Suspect duplicate backfill or unit bug.

maya_billing: Yikes. I'll check backfill/export logs. Did we run any embedding backfills on 2026-03-09? :thinking_face:

billing-bot: backfill-job #bfill-emb-20260309 started by scheduler at 2026-03-09T03:02:12Z

arjun_backend: There was a backfill but metering DB totals match ledger: 4,003,200. Running a quick export diff now.

arjun_backend: SQL run against replica: units = 4,003,200 (matches ledger).

carla_finance: Invoice has an extra zero -> likely exporter/export CSV bug (units vs multiplier).

jon_sales: ACME already pinged support: "Charged for 40M embeddings, dashboard shows 4M." Need urgent fix.

maya_billing: Found exporter CSV: embedding_units column shows 40032000. Exporter code had normalization_factor accidentally set to 10 in the 2026-03-09 02:58 UTC deploy.

arjun_backend: Confirmed deploy changed export.normalization_factor=10. Metering storage is fine. Root cause identified.

carla_finance: Action plan: 1) void and reissue corrected invoice 2) issue credit memo 3) re-export and dry-run 4) add alert for large export deltas.

kevin_cfo: Approved credit up to $48k. Proceed, loop me in if over threshold. :white_check_mark:

maya_billing: Will void INV-2026-03-09 and create INV-2026-03-09-R1 + CM-2026-03-09-ACME. Drafting customer message.

arjun_backend: Running re-export dry-run: `billing export reprocess --customer acme --start 2026-02-20 --end 2026-02-21 --dry-run` -> embedding_units=4,003,200.

jon_sales: Proposed customer message: "Hi ACME - we found an internal billing export bug that multiplied embedding usage by 10 for Feb 20-21. We've issued a corrected invoice and credit memo. Apologies."

kevin_cfo: Fine. Include invoice IDs and credit amount in email.

maya_billing: INV-2026-03-09-R1 and CM-2026-03-09-ACME created. Corrected embedding_units = 4,003,200. Sending to customer.

arjun_backend: Pushed exporter config assert in staging and added reconciliation job to flag >1.5x mismatches.

billing-bot: NOTE: adj-request created #adj-2026-03-09-acme by maya_billing

carla_finance: Finance will run a sweep to ensure no other invoices affected in that deploy window. Keep this thread updated.

jon_sales: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix - appreciate the transparency." :pray:
